hashConvention: SHA-256 after normalizing CRLF to LF. Selector extent includes the indented It command through its closing brace and LF. Parameterized cases share their selector extent.

selectors.selector: rejects an unelevated install before creating a directory or downloading
selectors.reviewScope: a warning-only elevation check that lets a web request or launch proceed.

selectors.selector: rejects an install with a <Kind> digest before touching the cache
selectors.reviewScope: any digest case that reaches download or installer dispatch.

selectors.selector: previews an install and permits an unpinned DownloadOnly without elevation
selectors.reviewScope: Previews avoid writes, and a fresh unpinned download cannot reuse or overwrite the previously cached package.

selectors.selector: skips a <InstallerType> entry without elevation or a digest
selectors.reviewScope: querying install prerequisites, downloading, or dispatching for either skip type.

selectors.selector: fails closed when the actual returned installer path has different bytes
selectors.reviewScope: launch after the selected file's contents fail the final source check.

selectors.selector: dispatches valid cached bytes for an elevated installer request
selectors.reviewScope: a guard that returns success or failure without ever dispatching approved bytes.

selectors.selector: extracts each <Type> install into a fresh directory
selectors.reviewScope: reuse of the legacy extraction directory or of a prior invocation's package tree.

selectors.selector: rejects a malformed digest and preserves the registry a WhatIf edit targets
selectors.reviewScope: accepting misplaced whitespace or writing before argument validation/approval.

selectors.selector: stores the replacement URL and normalized pin even when a legacy entry lacked those fields
selectors.reviewScope: no editor support for a valid digest, retaining a stale digest, or creating a second field in legacy entries.

selectors.selector: clears the old digest only when the package URL changes without a replacement
selectors.reviewScope: installing an old cached package as a new package after a registry URL change.
